rules.R2: An act word that is the first element of a hyphenated participle compound used attributively ('the snare-treated lesion', 'biopsy-proven Barrett esophagus', 'a clip-closed defect', 'APC-treated', 'band-ligated', 'snare-resected') is no act statement: services._acts_in drops the mention, and the compound's participle is no act predicate for any other mention (pass 3's has_act_verb and read_clause's performed test). A compound that is itself a predicate ('The polyp was snare-resected', 'was not snare-resected', 'we snare-resected it') reads as installed. The ACTS and BARE_PARTICIPLE patterns are unchanged (services.mention_count and H2(d) cannot move).
rules.R1: A lesion introduced under a label - a label token (COL-1, P1, 'Polyp 2', 'Lesion A', '#3') at the start of its line, then a separator, then anatomy or a lesion noun in the same clause - keeps that label in the reader's own label index (unique labels only: a label whose definitions name disjoint sites, or that two lesions would take, resolves to nothing). A later word-bounded, case-sensitive mention of the label in an act's clause, or a specimen reference equal to exactly one lesion's specimen, binds the act to that lesion, its service and its region BEFORE _family_for_act, the act and the lesion together; an act whose own clause names a site the lesion's tract cannot hold, two labels, or an unresolved label reads exactly as installed. A sized lesion restated under a known label (the specimen table) is that lesion, not a new one.
rules.R4: A report title (REPORT_TITLE, TITLE_FIELD, TITLE_REPORT_WORDS) that names two or more services is a combined title: its part, and every untitled part that falls back to it, is a report part of no single family; each named service still takes its title reading (performed), the combined title adds no whole-part scope and its own span is no scope of any one service; a site-less, label-less prose denial in such a part is set beside every service that documents the act done (the 'unplaced' extension), never dropped. Lands with or after R1.
rules.R3: Copular negation 'S was/were/is/are not a/an/the/any N (of|for) O': the 'not' negates only an act mention in N (as installed), never one in S (no new act: the subject refers to an act stated elsewhere) and never one in O or O's modifiers (no act there either); 'not a second/another/repeat/separate/further/additional N' denies another occurrence (NEG_OTHER's reading, uncertain), and 'not a second/another/repeat <service>' is never performance evidence (pass 1's promotion does not apply). Verbal negation ('The polyp was not removed with a snare.') is unchanged.
rules.R5: Minimal: a bare per-procedure section heading (parts() rule f) is NOT ended by a field-label line whose value follows on the next line (the label and the value name no act and no service, the value is short with no sentence stop, routing's layout reads no heading there), a table cell line, or page furniture (with the revision's pages: a line among a page's edge lines that recurs at the same edge of another page; a page-number line; a report title repeating an earlier one, which also opens no part). Every other heading still ends it, and the other-tract site override still wins. build() passes the revision's pages to parts() (and _act_frame does).
rules.R8: One shared pattern in cues.py, cues.EM_ABSENCE, for an explicit statement that no separate office E/M service, office visit or office-visit time is documented, performed, provided, rendered or occurred: a negator governing the visit mention with only visit qualifiers between them (separate, separately identifiable, significant, distinct, additional, office, clinic, outpatient, face-to-face, in-person, problem-oriented, same-day), the mention inside 'no <noun phrase> is/was documented|provided|performed|rendered|furnished|reported' or '... occurred/took place', or after the mention 'was/is not (separately) provided|documented|performed|rendered|furnished'. Read by detect._em_base_reading (a mention no other cue decides reads negated, cue 'negated: an explicit statement that no separate office E/M service is documented') and by services._em_service's E/M branch with that distinct cue. An affirmative E/M statement elsewhere outranks it (the denial is then held as uncertain, so a contradictory note still asks); billing wordings ('not billed separately', 'not separately billable', 'not separately reported') read as installed (owner question R2 Q-1).
rules.V7: engine._service_questions skips the gi.office_em documentation questions (setting, patient_status, em_basis) when the office E/M service is not established - the inventory reads it uncertain and every uncertain routing reading of it is the procedure-day EM_WITHOUT_BASIS hold - and no decidable E/M proposal (selected, or excluded and reinstatable) exists; they are kept when an E/M code is proposed or the visit is documented performed or incomplete. The unresolved-service count (completeness 'not established') is unchanged.
rules.R6: Optional, attempted only after R1-R5, R8 and V7 are green: a sentence's lesion takes the tract when every site it names lies in one tract. Dropped, and recorded as a limit, if any must-stay-held input or pinned test moves in the wrong direction. If attempted it moves tests/test_gi4_pi.py test_h4_04_the_rectal_polyps_bind_as_installed and H3 binding.lower-not-on-upper in the seeded S-h4-04 documents; both would be appended here as after-code movements.
